lead.t: Clinical Use: ACP serves as a marker for prostate cancer and is also utilized in forensic medicine (e.g., in rape cases) to detect the presence of semen.

qs.q: In forensic medicine, which enzyme is utilized to detect the presence of semen in rape cases?
qs.e: Acid Phosphatase (ACP) is used in forensic medicine to detect semen. Amylase is also present in semen but ACP is specifically highlighted for this forensic application in the note.
